name: Construction Work Jacket
subtitle: 12 oz waxed cotton canvas
description: Our take on the chore jacket, rebuilt around a dense 12 oz canvas that is lightly waxed after dyeing. Triple-needle seams, bar-tacked stress points and a corduroy-faced collar give it the kind of structure that softens to your shape over years, not weeks.
details: 12 oz cotton canvas, light wax finish
Four patch pockets with bar-tacked corners
Interior welt pocket with woven Cola Studio label
materials: 100% cotton canvas, 12 oz. Collar facing: 100% cotton corduroy.
care: Cold hand wash only — do not tumble dry
Re-wax seasonally to keep the finish
fit: Boxy and slightly cropped. Take your usual size for a layered fit.

name: Quilted Liner Jacket
subtitle: Diamond-quilted recycled nylon
description: A featherweight liner with real warmth. 60 g recycled padding is sealed in an onion-quilted shell, finished with knit-rib cuffs and a snap placket. Wear it alone in autumn or under a shell when winter arrives.
details: Snap placket with matte metal snaps
Two hand pockets with hidden snaps
Packs into its own inside pocket
materials: Shell & lining: 100% recycled nylon. Fill: 100% recycled polyester.
fit: Regular fit with room for a hoodie underneath.

name: Technical Down Parka
subtitle: 750 FP responsibly sourced down
description: Engineered for real cold. A matte, water-repellent ripstop shell is box-baffled to keep 750 fill-power down evenly distributed, while a storm flap, two-way zip and stowable hood seal out wind. Produced in a single, numbered run.
details: Two-way YKK® Vislon zip under a snap storm flap
materials: Shell: 100% nylon ripstop. Fill: 90% duck down, 10% feather.
care: Tumble dry low with dryer balls
fit: Generous, oversized volume. Size down for a closer fit.

name: Nylon Coach Jacket
subtitle: Crinkle nylon, mesh-lined
description: A clean, unfussy coach jacket in crinkled nylon with a soft hand. Mesh lining keeps it breathable, the drawcord hem lets you shape the silhouette, and a tonal monogram is embroidered at the back yoke.
details: Tonal monogram embroidery at back yoke

name: Double-Faced Wool Overcoat
subtitle: Hand-finished wool-cashmere blend
description: Cut from a double-faced wool and cashmere cloth, the seams on this coat are hand-folded and blind-stitched so it needs no lining at all. The result is a coat that drapes like a blanket and weighs almost nothing for its warmth.

name: 520 GSM Heavyweight Hoodie
subtitle: Brushed-back French terry
description: The studio's cornerstone. A 520 GSM loopback terry is brushed on the inside, garment-dyed and enzyme washed, so every hoodie arrives broken-in with its own subtle tonal variation. Double-layered hood, no drawcords — just a clean, heavy silhouette.
fit: Oversized with dropped shoulders. Size down for a regular fit.

name: Double-Face Zip Hoodie
subtitle: Two-tone bonded jersey
description: Two jersey layers are knitted together into one fabric, so the inside is a different tone than the outside. A two-way metal zip, flat drawcords with metal tips and a tall funnel-neck hood keep it sharp.
details: Two-way metal zip with leather pull

name: Loopback Crewneck
subtitle: 420 GSM organic cotton
description: A classic crewneck built properly: V-insert at the neck, raglan-free set-in sleeves for a cleaner shoulder and a dense loopback cotton that keeps its shape wash after wash.

name: Studio Sweatpants
subtitle: Matching 520 GSM terry
description: Built from the same brushed 520 GSM terry as our heavyweight hoodie. Deep pockets, a wide elasticated waistband with an internal drawcord and a straight leg that stacks cleanly over sneakers.
details: Deep side pockets and one back patch pocket
fit: Relaxed straight leg. True to size.

name: Heavyweight Boxy Tee
subtitle: 300 GSM compact jersey
description: The tee we wear every day. A compact-spun 300 GSM jersey with a dry, structured hand, a high 2.5 cm rib collar that never waves, and a boxy body with dropped shoulders.
fit: Boxy oversized fit. Size down for a regular fit.

name: Monogram Print Tee
subtitle: Puff-printed construction mark
description: Our boxy tee with the Cola Studio construction mark puff-printed on the chest — every line of the monogram printed at its true construction angle.

name: Waffle Longsleeve
subtitle: Open-knit thermal waffle
description: A thermal waffle knit with a deep, open texture that traps warmth without bulk. Long rib cuffs with thumb-friendly stretch and a slim-but-not-tight body for easy layering.

name: Pocket Tee
subtitle: Slub cotton, garment dyed
description: A lighter slub jersey with a natural, irregular texture, a single chest pocket and a garment-dyed colour that fades beautifully over time.

name: Chunky Rib Sweater
subtitle: 5-gauge merino-lambswool
description: Knitted on 5-gauge machines and fully fashioned — every panel is shaped as it is knitted, not cut, then linked by hand. The fisherman rib gives it depth and a surprising softness for its weight.
care: Hand wash cold with wool detergent

name: Brushed Mohair Cardigan
subtitle: Mohair-wool blend, horn buttons
description: A soft, hazy mohair cardigan brushed by hand after knitting to raise the fibres. Real horn buttons, deep patch pockets and a slightly cropped body.

name: Oversized Poplin Shirt
subtitle: Compact cotton poplin
description: An oversized shirt in crisp, compact poplin with a soft collar, a box pleat at the back yoke and mother-of-pearl buttons. Wears equally well tucked into trousers or open over a tee.
fit: Oversized fit. Size down for a regular fit.

name: Corduroy Overshirt
subtitle: 8-wale cotton corduroy
description: A heavier overshirt in 8-wale corduroy with two flapped chest pockets and corozo buttons. Structured enough to work as a light jacket.

name: Pleated Wide Trouser
subtitle: Wool-feel twill, double pleat
description: A wide, double-pleated trouser in a dry twill with the drape of wool. Extended waistband with side adjusters, French bearer and a deep, sharp front crease.
fit: Wide leg, high rise. True to size.

name: Carpenter Denim
subtitle: 14 oz selvedge denim
description: Woven on vintage shuttle looms, this 14 oz selvedge denim is cut into a relaxed carpenter jean with a hammer loop and utility pocket. It will fade to a record of how you wear it.
fit: Relaxed straight leg. Take your usual waist size.

name: Utility Cargo Pant
subtitle: Cotton ripstop, 8 pockets
description: A cargo pant without the costume. Bellowed pockets sit flat until needed, articulated knees follow movement and an adjustable hem lets you wear it straight or tapered.
details: Bellowed cargo pockets with hidden snaps

name: Pleated Track Short
subtitle: Technical nylon, 7" inseam
description: A relaxed short in quick-drying technical nylon with a single front pleat for extra volume and a mesh-lined pocket bag.

name: Six-Panel Cap
subtitle: Washed cotton twill
description: An unstructured six-panel cap in washed cotton twill with an embroidered monogram, a pre-curved brim and a brass slider closure.

name: Ribbed Merino Beanie
subtitle: Fine-gauge extra-fine merino
description: A fisherman beanie in extra-fine merino with a deep double-layer cuff and a woven label at the fold.

name: Canvas Tote
subtitle: 18 oz duck canvas, leather handles
description: A structured tote in 18 oz duck canvas with vegetable-tanned leather handles, an internal zip pocket and a base that stands on its own.

name: Utility Crossbody
subtitle: Cordura® nylon, magnetic buckle
description: A compact crossbody with a water-resistant Cordura® body, a magnetic Fidlock-style buckle and organised interior pockets for everyday carry.

name: Studio Socks — 3 Pack
subtitle: Combed cotton, cushioned sole
description: Three pairs of mid-calf socks in combed cotton with a cushioned sole, seamless toe and a jacquard monogram at the cuff.
